name: Legendary Investigator
body:
LEGENDARY INVESTIGATOR CR 6

XP 2,400
Female legendary investigator 7
LN Medium humanoid (changeling)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 17 (+4 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge), touch 13, flat-footed 14
hp 35 (7d8)
Fort +2, Ref +7, Will +7 (+9 vs illusions)
Defensive Abilities danger sense +2, mistchild (increased concealment from fog 5%)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.

Melee cold iron dagger +5 (1d4/19-20 x2)
Ranged +1 hand crossbow +8 (1d4+1/19-20 x2)
Special Attacks studied combat (swift action), studied strike +4d6
Changeling Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +10)

1/Day–dancing lights, detect magic, disguise self (DC 14), pass without trace

Legendary Investigator Extracts Prepared (CL 7th)

2nd–cure moderate wounds, delay poison, investigative mind
1st–cure light wounds (x2), heightened awareness, invisibility alarm, recharge innate magic, shield

TACTICS

Before Combat The legendary investigator is not inherently a fighter. While she is not above taking down a bad guy, she would rather avoid conflict and will use all of her skills and guile to do so. If the legendary investigator is aware of an unavoidable, impending combat, she will use her heightened awareness and shield extracts to give her better initiative and more protection. If she thinks she will need the extra boost in combat versus a later investigation, she will down her potion of fox’s cunning.

During Combat The legendary investigator will take her time to study her target and learn their weaknesses. She will open combat by activating her studied combat on the strongest-looking enemy. She will then focus her attacks there while keeping distance between her and any combatant. She will use her healing abilities on allies before herself because it is her duty.

Morale She will do anything in her power to heal allies, but she is not willing to sacrifice her own life needlessly. If she can retreat and find a better approach, she will. If she can survive an encounter, there will always be another opportunity to defeat her opponent.

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 16
Base Attack +5, CMB +5, CMD 17
Feats Detect Expertise, Dodge, Extra Inspiration, Skill Focus (Heal)
Skills Acrobatics +7, Appraise +9, Craft (Alchemy) +12, Diplomacy +9 (+10 for gather information), Disable Device +7, Escape Artist +7, Heal +20 (+24 vs. medical evidence tampering), Knowledge (arcana), +9, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +8, Knowledge (engineering) +8, Knowledge (geography) +8, Knowledge (history) +11, Knowledge (local) +11, Knowledge (nature) +10, Knowledge (nobility) +9, Knowledge (planes) +8, Knowledge (religion) +9, Linguistics +10, Perception +14 (+17 to identify potions), Profession (doctor) +8, Sense Motive +12, Sleight of Hand +7, Spellcraft +9, Stealth +7, Use Magic Device +9; Int in place of normal ability modifier for Diplomacy (gather information), Heal, Perception and Sense Motive; +1/2 legendary investigator level to Heal (doubled vs. tampering in medical evidence), +1/2 legendary investigator level to Perception on identifying potions
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, Ratfolk
SQ amazing inspiration (investigator talent), competent treatment, course of study (medicine), expert medicine, hag magic, inspiration (10, d8), keen recollection, mist child, piercing the veil, quick study (investigator talent), quick wits, stimulate the mind, witchborn
Gear +1 hand crossbow, 10 silver bolts, 10 bolts, cold iron dagger, mithral chain shirt, alchemy crafting kit, book of letters, doctor’s outfit, doctor’s mask, eyeglasses, healer’s kit, journal, magnifying glass, spring-loaded wrist sheath (dagger), surgeon’s tools, thermometer, tome of epics, potion of cure light wounds (x2), potion of remove sickness, potion of fox’s cunning, formula book [contains prepared formulae as well as the following: 1st: blend, comprehend languages, identify], medical examiner badge (50 gp), 187 gp

BOON

The legendary investigator has an ever-curious mind and a thirst for solving mysteries. As long as the PCs are on the side of the law or give her a suitable gift of literature, for which she has a great interest in ancient epics and histories, she can be made friendly with a DC 12 Diplomacy check. If the PCs aid her in an investigation her disposition automatically changes to friendly. If at least friendly, the legendary investigator will write a letter of reference for any noble or government agency in the city which will aid in any Diplomacy check made with the person in question. Additionally, she will aid in any research done, granting the use of her Knowledge checks to the PCs once per week.

Otherwise, the legendary investigator will pass along information to the PCs if she thinks it will aid in one of her investigations.
